source.file: 01.公开版-成都地铁线路3.0-a运营版（至2026年11月）纯色底.jpg
source.coordinateConvention: Original coordinates refer to the 6300x4500 source. Cropped coordinates subtract [1250,400]; no geographic coordinate inference.
source.method: PIL source crops inspected at 5x and 7x; neutral-dark OpenCV contour measurements on native pixels for the interchange capsule; local line-color connected components for the terminal marker. JPEG threshold sensitivity is recorded instead of treating inner holes as outer symbols.

tianfuStation.sourceLabel: 天府站 / Tianfu Station / （仅换乘）
tianfuStation.interpretation: The black capsule is the operating 18/19 metro interchange. It is not a future national-rail icon, not a second station and not a railway-transfer badge.

outerMeasurement.uncertainty: Center stable within about 0.5 source pixel across thresholds. Outer dimensions vary with antialiasing and JPEG ringing.

oldOverrideComparison.rootCause: The old Y is about 9.4 source pixels too far down. A route forced through it leaves the actual parallel tracks and can be attracted to the lower turnout or depot branch.

line19TerminalTail.kind: source schematic line-end tail and line-number marker

terminalMarker.appearance: Light-purple 19-line core with neutral-gray outer rim; adjacent 19 / 4A / 62.7 badge. No independent station name is printed beside this circle.

grayRimMeasurement.threshold: neutral max<190; nearby line-color core excluded

line19TerminalTail.visibleStrokeWidth: About 7-10 source pixels on the purple arc, varying with its diagonal section; use the ordinary 19 line width for a normalized single-stroke rendition.

attachment.note: The outgoing purple tail emerges below the common diagonal bundle and is partly covered/blended by the dark-teal 18 stroke. The first reliable pure-purple center samples start at [3705,3545]. A connection from the station to this tail is a source-layout interpolation through that occlusion, not a newly measured extra station. Do not reroute the airport through-service along this downward arc.

line19TerminalTail.whyMarkerAndStationAreSeparate: The source legend names the 19 main route as 金星—天府站—合江, with 合江 gray. The lower circle has only a 19 badge and no independent passenger-station name. It therefore represents the source's line-end/turnback-direction graphic beyond the shared interchange, not a second 天府站. Its visual separation is source layout, not a geographic station separation inferred from coordinates. Official information confirms that 19 joins 18 at Tianfu and continues to the airport; it does not make 合江 an open passenger station.
line19TerminalTail.interpretationLimit: The source alone does not establish whether the lower circle denotes the engineering end, a turnback limit or a schematic terminus offset. Keep its visible geometry, but do not assign a new station identity or claim an exact engineering boundary.

airportCommonSection.sourceAppearance: A light-purple 19 band stays on the upper/northeastern side of the dark-teal 18 band and continues diagonally southeast beyond the Tianfu capsule. Gold/light inner decorations belong to the reference's track style and are not extra route branches.
airportCommonSection.drawingRecommendation: Keep both existing parallel 18 and 19 through-service bands on the source main bundle, anchored at the corrected Tianfu capsule. Add the downward purple tail as another non-roster path for 19. Do not replace the airport common section with the tail or connect it to a depot.

line18DepotBranch.appearance: Thin dark-teal line leaves the main bundle farther southeast than the purple tail and continues to a stylized depot fan below the crop.
line18DepotBranch.differenceFromLine19Tail: The depot lead is much thinner and dark teal; the 19 terminal tail is broad light purple and ends at the 19 badge circle. Color and endpoint are distinct in the native image.
line18DepotBranch.drawingRecommendation: Exclude this depot lead from station-to-station passenger tracing. If depot artwork is retained at all, keep it as noninteractive background geometry.

officialCrossCheck.publisher: 成都地铁官方供稿／四川在线，2023-11-27
officialCrossCheck.supports: 19二期经天府站接入18号线并共线运营至天府机场北，合江为预留站；不支持把图面末端圆点当作已开放的合江客运站。
运营方说明天府站仅能站内换乘18、19号线，出入口暂未开启；与原图（仅换乘）标注一致。

scope: Independent source review only. No existing data, roster, route, symbol override or extraction script was changed.
